_comment: cg27a_distillcap5: cg27a_distillcap on seed 5 + the chunked probe evaluation (memory; evaluation unchanged). Keys starting with _ are ignored by scripts/merge_overrides.py.
_inf_jx: train the index each sleep and print the JEPA INDEX readouts; readouts only, the trunk is not trained
_inf_jx_dim: encoder width and depth (about 3M parameters); local runs use 128 x 3
_inf_jx_nce: 0 = pure V-JEPA (EMA target, L1, no negatives); > 0 adds InfoNCE over the batch (the toy: helps when facts share a subject)
_inf_jx_pool: the most recent live stored sentences that are keyed
_inf_jx_arm_nce: arm C: a second encoder trained with this InfoNCE weight added to the L1 (local end of run top-1 0.85 against 0.76 for arm V)
_inf_jx_gen: arm G, the generic trace: names found by the store's own name finder are masked before encoding and kept as slots; retrieval among the sentences whose slots hold the question's name, ranked by the name-free key (local HYBRID 1.00)
_inf_jx_pair: paired-wording training stays off: locally it did not raise held-out retrieval (0.12 with it against 0.15 without)
_inf_jx_route: JEPA ROUTING readout: each visit's stored sentences in 1 KB windows routed by bytes, by JEPA codes and by both, at 1 and 4 windows; routing itself unchanged
_cd_klclass: REPLAY SIGNAL BY BYTE CLASS readout: every 25th conduit call, share of the teacher KL and byte loss on space/punctuation, digits, function words, names and other words
_inf_jx_gen_nce: InfoNCE weight on arm G (the generic trace): on the GPU the L1-only arms collapsed in the first sleeps (key spread 0.17-0.24) before recovering
_inf_jx_ctxdiag: CONTEXT DIAGNOSTIC line: one-hop picks by summed and by mean byte log-probability, the planted fact sentence in context, whether the stored true sentence holds the fact, share of wrong picks that are shorter names, two examples
_inf_jx_gen_aud: weight of the audit-pair InfoNCE on arm G: question form 'So A is connected to ' -> the premise the audit verified, against other sentences naming the same name (toy, 2 seeds: held-out wording 0.08 -> 0.36, two-hop 0.43 -> 0.49)
_cd_store_text: the fast store (hippocampus) also reads the plain text of closed-loop visits; the trunk still learns only from verified replays (local, no hints: updated one-hop 0.00 -> 0.80, stale 1.00 -> 0.20; two-hop with the store 0.40 -> 0.71; final BPC 2.554 -> 2.562, within noise)
_cd_mem_hint: memory hints stay off: locally they never fired (replays failed before a verified anchor); N > 0 lets the stored sentence matching the verified bytes before a replay's first wrong byte supply up to N bytes
_inf_conc_wordings: conclusions written in several wordings (common._CONC_FWD / _CONC_REV, none a test wording) in TRUNK REPLAY only; the fast store keeps one canonical form (inf_conc_wordings_store 0, the default)
_inf_cons_contrast: competitor contrast in conclusion replay: softplus(logit(negative) - logit(answer)) at the byte where each negative name leaves the answer
_inf_cons_contrast_k: negatives per row: other live conclusions' answers in the same role, never a true answer of the given name
_inf_cons_infow: information-weighted answer bytes: w = s / mean(s), s = bits of the byte after a neutral cue (the given name replaced by someone), clipped to [0.25, 4]
_inf_cf_wordings: closed-form edits fitted on the keys of the first 3 wordings of common._CONC_CF (the first is the original)
_inf_cf_contrast: competitor contrast in the closed-form edit fit (divergence byte, as in replay)
_inf_selcmp: readout at the end of the run (north-star rung 0): trained JEPA selector against closed-form CCA/SFA (plain and weighted beyond a shuffled null), trunk cosine, TF-IDF names, random; retrieval incl. held-out wording, judge, Re-DocRED relations
_inf_rdr_judge: readout at the end of the run: relational signal in the trunk on Re-DocRED prose (substitution and mutual-compression AUC)
_inf_open_diag: per visit: teacher-forced open-ended diagnostic (open hit, answer bytes top-1, first-byte rank, bits behind, winner a letter) for the fitted, other written and held-out wordings; at pass ends and the end, RUNG 3 KEYS (held-out question -> own conclusion by nearest fitted key)
_inf_cf_shadow: on: shadow edits - NAME-KEYED variants incl. NAME x POSITION, ROME-STYLE subject-site edit (a plain weight edit, no oracle positions), information-weighted fits, SOURCE FACTS; each applied alone and removed (readout only)
_inf_eval_trie_inv: known-name decoding over every capitalised word of the stored sentences (local: 5067 names, target always present) instead of the fast store's names
_inf_cf_selfc: self-contrast in the closed-form edit: every answer byte must beat the model's own top non-answer byte (fixed from the unedited model), beside competitor contrast; GPU shadow edits (3 sleeps, 42 conclusions): fitted open 0.17 -> 0.57, held-out MC 0.48 -> 0.65, held-out answer bytes top-1 0.66 -> 0.80, held-out open 0/84 -> 6/84 (shadow without competitor contrast); local: no change (2 seeds)
_inf_latent_judge: LATENT JUDGE readout in sleep: slow-feature cosine on the pairs the byte judge tests (AUC vs controls / random, cost per pair); the byte judge still decides
_sticky_router_eval: STICKY ROUTING readout on mixed held-out streams at pass ends, with the rule cascade signals as reset gates (readout only)
_readouts_9nov: readouts only beyond cg27a_selfc: answer-slot gates (linear / SERAC-style / WISE-style), system-written question forms in the shadow edits, ROME-style fit diagnostic, latent judge hard controls, sleep phases, ceiling tests last
_inf_distill_wake_params: the ONE model change against cg27a_distillw: only the blocks' mlp_out weights take the question gradient (embeddings, shared n-gram tables, heads, mixers get none); local short runs: final BPC +0.010 vs +0.052 with every parameter, Gaussian drift of old domains at the replay-only level
_inf_gauss_drift: readout: per-layer W2 (Bures) drift of the old domains' hidden-state Gaussians on fixed stored sentences, sleep to sleep
_inf_sleep_phase_free: memory: CUDA cache released after each timed sleep phase; the SLEEP PHASES line now gives each phase's own GPU peak
_inf_mem_guard: memory: lean sleeps (latent readouts off, CLS samples halved, caches dropped) once a peak passes 60% of the device (was 70%)
_inf_distill_pool_max: the ONE model change against cg27a_distillm: question pool up to 2000 facts and conclusions from the store, beyond the name memory's cap (GPU cg27a_distillm: the memory reached 381 of 384 entries at visit 4, so the taught set stopped growing at about 300)
_inf_distill_ever: readout: recall over a stable sample of every fact ever taught (and control ever held), by still/left the pool and by age
_inf_eval_chunk: memory: the probe evaluation in chunks of 128 rows (the 70 GB sleep peak); evaluation results unchanged
